meta.name: TanStack May 2026 compromise
meta.incident: 2026-05-11: 84 malicious versions across 42 @tanstack packages published via a breached CI pipeline; worm self-propagated to 160+ npm/PyPI packages by republishing everything compromised maintainers owned
meta.provenance: Captured from the public npm registry API with `hyperdefense snapshot`. Real registry data, not synthetic: package metadata, maintainer lists, and publish timestamps are exactly as npm served them at capturedAt.
